verdict.rationale: Viewport control is a fair question for a web-scraping and browser-automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions setting viewport width or height. The only related item is a note that Apify works with Playwright and Puppeteer; those are third-party libraries a developer would configure themselves, not an Apify-documented viewport capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control the browser viewport width and height when rendering a page
